note: Animal places and their daily trips (docs/design/ANIMAL_ROUTINES_TRAILS_TRAPPING.md, 22 Nov 2026, PROVISIONAL TR-1 to TR-5). Places are worked out from position (a hash of the square with the world seed), never saved: a rabbit warren in some warren.cell_m squares, a deer range (bed and feeding ground) in each 256 m trail block. The route between a place's two spots is the game trail; animals made at a place walk it at the hours of their species' clock. Blocks are worked out when a player needs them, within budget_ms a tick, and dropped forget_s after no player is near.

warren.note: TR-1: European rabbits live in warrens on open, well-drained grassland and graze out from them along their runs, near the warren first and farther as it gets dark (NSW DPI; Agriculture Victoria). chance is per square, times the rabbit biome weight there.

deer.note: TR-2: deer bed by day in sheltered ground, side ground near bed_best slope when there is some, and walk a set trail to feed on open flat ground at dusk (onX; Mississippi State: food and bedding within about 180 m, buck day travel about 900 m). One range per trail block where deer live; tries candidate spots.

moose.note: TR-8 (stage 2a, D-TRAP-3): moose bed on side ground and feed longest at dawn and dusk (scienceinsights, citing studies), at wet ground and water edges (willow, pond weed): its feeding ground is a spot with deep water within feed_wet_m when there is one, else the flattest. Its trail is a deer trail (kind 1). Own spots (salt) so a deer and a moose range in one block lie apart.

elk.note: TR-8: elk keep a deer's day (crepuscular like deer and moose, as their animals.json active row says: day 0.6, dusk 1.0, night 0.3): bed by day, feed on open ground at dusk and dawn, on a deer trail. A little farther apart than deer (larger animals, larger ranges).

route.note: TR-3: a point every step_m, each tried a side_m or two either side of the last one's line and the one with the gentlest climb kept (lines of least resistance round hills and banks), drifting at most max_side_m off the straight line and back by the end; side_w a metre keeps it from wandering for nothing; deep water is refused. Then a small sideways wiggle every wiggle_step_m so the trail is not ruler straight.

clock.note: TR-4: the hour an animal leaves for its out spot (out_hour) and comes back home (home_hour), each animal a fixed share of jitter_h either side (from its id) so they do not all go at once. Rabbits: out from late afternoon to early morning, home after dawn (NSW DPI, Agriculture Victoria). Deer: to the feeding ground at dusk, back to bed after the dawn feed (onX, Mississippi State, theHunter's whitetail zones).
clock.note_sun: TR-7 (stage 2a, D-TRAP-3): with the sun known, out is sunset + out_after_sunset_h and home is sunrise + home_after_sunrise_h (rabbits out an hour before sunset and home an hour after sunrise: NSW DPI; deer, moose and elk out half an hour before sunset, back half an hour after sunrise: onX, Delisle et al. 2024). At the equinox (sunrise 6, sunset 18) that is close to the fixed hours, which stay for a server without a sun.
